_doc: Marksman line (spec #360, ticket MS2 #362): the skill definitions of the Marksman (322), empty until the skill tickets land. Each ticket appends its own region (a repeated key across files is a load error): MS5 #365 iron_arrow (moved here from skills/bowman.json), strafe_crossbow, dragons_breath_crossbow; MS6 #366 blizzard_crossbow, arrow_eruption; MS7 #367 piercing_arrow; MS8 #368 snipe; MS9 #369 golden_eagle, frostprey. arrow_blow is Bowmaster's shared definition in skills/bowmaster.json and is not redefined here.

iron_arrow.name: Iron Arrow: Crossbow
iron_arrow.desc: Fires a piercing arrow that loses damage with each monster struck.
iron_arrow._tier: Tier A: canonical crossbow weapon 46, mobCount 6 (pierce 5), damage 122..180%, ball/effect/hit art and the Use sound, all 30 levels. Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.49): ported from skills/bowman.json (the weapon gate and the explicit 30 ranks are gone: the default eight ranks, rank 8 is WZ level 30), nearest target, 1s cooldown, 300px reach, 600px/s flight, 8px radius, 0.6s held-weapon shooting hold; one base arrow; linear 0.1 fall-off per contact, floor 0.1 (sixth mob 50%); rarity bonuses named after the Crossbowman passives. Untuned.

strafe_crossbow.name: Strafe
strafe_crossbow.desc: Fires a volley of crossbow bolts at one monster.
strafe_crossbow._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 71..100% per arrow, bulletCount 4, weapon 46 (crossbow), hit/0 art (3 frames) and the Use sound (a UOL into the 3111006 node; the art and numbers are node for node the Bowmaster's). Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.49): a crossbow copy of `strafe` with its own id, book and job so the Skill window lists it on the Sniper tab (the Bowmaster's shared key would sit on no tab of a Marksman); the eight survivor ranks, `cast.focus`, 2.5s cooldown, 350px range, 700px/s, 6px radius, no pierce, 0.6s held weapon stance, rarity bonuses. Untuned.

dragons_breath_crossbow.name: Dragon's Breath
dragons_breath_crossbow.desc: Looses a dragon-fire arrow that pierces a line of monsters and knocks each one back.
dragons_breath_crossbow._tier: Tier A: WZ damage 42..100%, mobCount 4..6, range 440 (read from the level), prop 100, weapon 46 (crossbow), ball/hit/effect art and the Use/Hit sounds (UOLs into the 3121001 node; the art and numbers are node for node the Bowmaster's). Tier C (MS5 #365, GAME_DESIGN 7.49): a crossbow copy of `dragons_breath` with its own id, book and job (Marksman tab); the eight survivor ranks, nearest auto-cast with its own ball (no ammo sprite), 3.5s cooldown, 700px/s, 16px radius, `pierce_field` mobCount (pierces mobCount - 1), a 180px knock-back that always rolls (prop 100; bosses are damaged and not moved), 0.6s held weapon stance, rarity bonuses. Untuned.
